Draft privacy policy

Your information,

This is sample policy content and needs legal review before publication.

What we collect

When you make an enquiry, we may collect your name, phone number, email address, preferred date, treatment interest and message.

How we use it

We use it to respond to your enquiry, assess booking suitability, manage appointments and send requested Academy information. We do not sell enquiry information.

Health information

Any health-screening details are handled only for consultation and treatment-suitability purposes, with appropriate confidentiality.

Your choices

You may ask to access, correct or remove information held for your enquiry by contacting hello@browliciouspmu.in. This sample contact address must be replaced before launch.
